newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Last auction due Aug 12 to sell Hanbo.
newsitem.headline: Last auction due Aug 12 to sell Hanbo.

text.p: The Korea First Bank, the main creditor of failed Hanbo Steel Co, said on Friday it planned to hold an auction on August 12 to sell off Hanbo.
It would be the third and last time for the steelmaker to be put up for auction, a Korea First spokesman said.
The plan is subject to an approval at a meeting of major creditors set for 3.00 p.m. (0600 GMT) on Friday, he said.
No bidders showed up for the past two auctions. Instead, Pohang Iron and Steel Co and Dong Kuk Steel Mill Co have offered to buy Hanbo's fixed assets.
The Korea First spokesman said if the third auction failed again, creditors would consider either starting negotiations on the Pohang Iron offer or inviting others for private takeover negotiations.
Hanbo Steel was declared insolvent in late January under some five trillion won in debts.
Pohang Iron and Dong Kuk estimated the price for their offer at around two trillion won, while the latest official evaluation put Hanbo's fixed assets at 4.15 trillion.
